topics.content:
WEEKLY ASSESSMENT BOOK
SOCIAL STUDIES
Attempt all the questions
WEEK 1 - Meaning of Social Studies
1. _________________________ is the study of man and his environment.
A. Social Studies
B. Society Studies
C. English Studies
2. _________________________ is also the study of man and how he lives with one another.
A. Social Studies
B. Society Studies
C. English Studies
3. _________________________ is the study of how man and how his problems are solved in the environment.
A. Social Studies
B. Society Studies
C. English Studies
4. Social Studies is the study of _________________________ and _________________________.
A. Man and woman
B. Man and Animals
C. Man and his environment
4. People in our environment also include - our father, mother, brothers and sisters, uncles and auntie, neighbours, etc.
A. True
B. Yes
C. All of the above
Mention 2 names of people in your family.
